user.title: CariPasarMalam
user.description: Find nearby night markets (pasar malam) across Malaysia for your Home zone and tracked persons with live GPS coordinates.

data_description.home_radius: Search radius around your Home zone in kilometers (1 to 50 km).
data_description.person_radius: Search radius around each tracked person's current GPS location (1 to 50 km).
data_description.state_filter: Choose 'all' for all Malaysia, or select a specific state to filter.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to recalculate proximity and check market schedules (5 to 1440 minutes).

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to pasarmalam.app API. Please check your internet connection.

abort.single_instance_allowed: CariPasarMalam is already configured. Only a single instance is supported.

init.title: CariPasarMalam Options
init.description: Adjust search radius, tracked persons, state filters, and update intervals.

data_description.home_radius: Search radius around your Home zone in kilometers (1 to 50 km).
data_description.person_radius: Search radius around each tracked person's current GPS location (1 to 50 km).
data_description.state_filter: Choose 'all' for all Malaysia, or select a specific state to filter.
data_description.tracked_persons: Select specific person entities to track, or leave empty to track all persons with GPS.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to recalculate proximity and check market schedules (5 to 1440 minutes).

get_nearby.name: Get Nearby Pasar Malam
get_nearby.description: Find night markets (pasar malam) within a specified radius of a person, zone, or GPS coordinates.

entity_id.name: Location Entity
entity_id.description: The person or zone entity to search around. Defaults to zone.home.

latitude.name: Latitude
latitude.description: GPS Latitude (if not using an entity).

longitude.name: Longitude
longitude.description: GPS Longitude (if not using an entity).

day.name: Day Filter
day.description: Day to filter markets by ('today', 'tomorrow', 'all', or specific day like 'mon').

limit.name: Result Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of markets to return.
